name: Signal Desktop
param_style: better-sqlite3 API on @signalapp/sqlcipher: $name parameters in plain prepare() strings, and the sql`` tagged template (ts/sql/util.std.ts) that emits positional ? and inlines sqlConstant() literals
schema_source: reconstructed by replaying ts/sql/migrations (index.node.ts versions 1-40, then <N>-*.ts in order) and keeping only the tables the queries use; final triggers from 1500-search-polls, 45-stories and Server.node.ts; messages_fts tokenizer changed from signal_tokenizer to unicode61
data_scale: scale 1: 300 conversations, 60k messages (5 busy conversations hold ~35%), ~12k message_attachments, ~2k callsHistory, 7k reactions, ~900 edits, ~2.9k attachment download jobs, 3k sync tasks; ~85 MB
visibility_note: Official Signal desktop client; every Signal desktop install keeps its whole message history in this SQLite (SQLCipher) database
interest_note: Messages table with ~40 indexes, many over generated columns (JSON-derived and CASE-derived), forced with INDEXED BY; FTS5 search staged through rowid temp tables with snippet() and a FULL OUTER JOIN against mentions; the call-history grouping query with three correlated subqueries per row, JSON_GROUP_ARRAY and a LAG() window.
reach_note: tens of millions of desktop installs; every message view and search goes through this SQL
